title: Platinum Rewards Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Friends
summary: This document explains the Platinum Rewards Card referral program: invite friends from your account, and earn a $100 referral bonus for each approved friend who spends at least $1,500 within 90 days of account opening. You can earn up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year; self-referrals and duplicate applications don’t qualify, and bonuses are typically credited after approval and qualifying spend.
